comment: Specs stay INCLUDED here on purpose, so `check` type-checks them; only
`tsconfig.build.json` drops them, because `files` publishes `lib/` and an
emitted spec would ship. ALL THREE test entries are excluded from both: each
is compiled by its own test task, which resolves `@gjsify/unit` for it.
Only `src/test.mts` was listed at first, so `tsc` also compiled
devDependency CI does not install. `gjsify tsc` then failed with TS2307 and
the package's declared outputs were never written, which surfaced as twelve
missing paths and kicked #2188 out of the merge queue.
`DOM` is in `lib` for `src/client/`, the only tree that runs in a browser;
it is bundled by `build:client`, never emitted into `lib/*.js` as a module.
